---
name: Architecture decision
about: Propose a material technical or security decision
title: "adr: "
labels: "type:research,needs:decision"
---

## Purpose and audience

Architects, security reviewers, and affected feature owners use this issue to prepare a material decision for ADR review.

## Context and decision deadline

Describe the problem, constraints, stakeholders, dependencies, and consequence of deferral.

## Options and evidence

Compare at least viable options across security, tenancy, reliability, cost, operability, team learning, migration, and scope. Identify assumptions rather than presenting them as facts.

## Proposed decision

State consequences, validation plan, owner, required reviewers, and affected ADR/documents. Acceptance requires a numbered ADR with status.
